gen-comfortaa-gf-shippori-antique-b1: Shippori Antique B1 reads with daylight in every curve, its line plain and unhurried. Comfortaa is best when it rounds out a big, friendly title, and the body font is best when it simply carries the words.
gen-comfortaa-gf-sn-pro: Comfortaa leads with a rounded-wire look, each letter bent from one smooth strand of tube. SN Pro follows with open, modern curves that keep the stroke quality low and the text easy to move through.
gen-comfortaa-gf-snippet: Approachable from the first word, this pair starts with Comfortaa's ring-shaped round letters up top. Snippet takes over below with a wire-bent sans that is made for carrying the sentences themselves.
gen-comfortaa-gf-source-sans-3: Friendly geometry up top, with Comfortaa's rounded strokes holding the same thickness in every direction they turn. Source Sans 3 below suits a modest size.
gen-comfortaa-gf-special-gothic: Special Gothic reads with rounded letters that stay open and inviting, easy on the eye from line to line. Comfortaa earns its keep big and brief.
gen-comfortaa-gf-stick: Tube-bent letters, then straight-faced text. Comfortaa's ring-like round shapes lead, and Stick keeps a longer passage moving smoothly, its constant lines letting light through every exit.
gen-comfortaa-gf-suse: SUSE reads with rope-thick curves and bowls tipped open toward you, which feels approachable in a plain sans way. Over a longer passage it stays easy.
gen-comfortaa-gf-suse-mono: Professional but still approachable, this pair sets Comfortaa's neon-tube heading, with curves and straights sharing one width, big and short. SUSE Mono follows with open curves and generous gaps around each letter.
gen-comfortaa-gf-tajawal: Comfortaa bends every glyph like cable, with no swelling or thinning, so its wide ring-shaped c stands out. Tajawal handles running text with a broad, open hook, and it does so quietly.
